title: Organizational Leadership, B.A. (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: Scraped 2025-2026 bulletin archive via bulletin_scraper.py. Plan structure reflects the 2025-2026 bulletin exactly: OLEAD core sequence (100/201/210/464/465), PSYCH 100 (GS requirement) + PSYCH 484, major course pools (Critical Thinking: IST 110 or PHIL 10; Organizational Behavior: PSYCH 281 or LHR 202; Conflict Management: LHR 312/SOC 207/LHR 437/CAS 404; Ethics: PHIL 119 or LHR 460), Writing Across the Curriculum slot (LHR 458Y suggested), plus LA 83 in semester 1 and LA 283 in semester 4. All course codes from scraper's linked_codes (unverified_codes list is empty). Semester total_credits match scraper subtotals: Fall 17.5, Spring 16, Fall 16, Spring 16.5, Fall 15, Spring 15, Fall 13.5, Spring 13.5 = 123 total (matches bulletin printed total). QUALITY-AUDIT FIX: the original builder pass deliberately left PSYCH 484 unschedulable here (self_verification_passed=false, 'Could not schedule ... PSYCH 484'), reasoning that the 2025 bulletin's own suggested plan doesn't list PSYCH 200/STAT 200 or the MATH 3/4/21 chain those require. But PSYCH 484's real prereq (PSYCH 100 AND (PSYCH 200 or STAT 200), STAT 200 requiring MATH 21) is a catalog-level fact about psych_catalog.json/stat_catalog.json, not a year-specific curriculum difference -- it applies identically regardless of catalog year, exactly like the CHEM 110/MATH chain fixes already applied identically across every NROSCI/PESBH historical year in this same repo. Added MATH 3 (Semester 1), MATH 4 (Semester 2), MATH 21 (Semester 3), and PSYCH 200 (or STAT 200, Semester 4) explicitly, matching OLEAD-2026.json's own identical fix verbatim. Re-verified with build_full_plan(start_year=2025, today=2025-07-01): 0 'Could not schedule' warnings (previously 1). QUALITY-AUDIT FIX #2: the original builder pass modeled Semester 4's 'LA 283' as a real "course" item (options: ["LA 283"]), but a raw-HTML check of the archived 2025-26 page shows that cell has NO <a> link (plain text 'LA 283' in a <td>, unlike the real, linked 'LA 83' in Semester 1) -- bulletin_scraper.py itself reports zero linked_codes for this item (is_generic_slot=true), and LA 283 is not present in la_catalog.json either. This is the exact 'LA 283' code OLEAD-2026.json's and OLEADBS-2026.json's own notes already flagged by name as unconfirmed and deliberately modeled as a generic slot instead -- the 2025 file had fabricated it as a definite course code anyway, which build_full_plan silently scheduled with a synthesized 'LA 283' display name (no warning, since the engine schedules whatever code is in the JSON without checking it against the catalog). Converted to a generic 'slot' item, matching the 2026 file's own established treatment.
